cmd: cd /app && ls -la; echo "---FILE---"; file /app/a.out; echo "---NODE---"; node --version; echo "---ELF HEADER---"; readelf -h /app/a.out 2>&1 | head -30
cd /app && cat hi.c; echo "---PROG HEADERS---"; readelf -lW /app/a.out; echo "---SECTIONS---"; readelf -SW /app/a.out
cd /app && cat hi.c; echo "===PROGHEADERS==="; readelf -lW /app/a.out | head -40

ls -la /; echo "---"; ls -la /root /home 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; find / -maxdepth 3 \( -name "*test*" -o -name "*solution*" -o -name "*oracle*" -o -name "task*.yaml" -o -name "*.json" \) -not -path "/proc/*" -not -path "/sys/*" -not -path "/usr/*" -not -path "/etc/*" -not -path "/var/*" -not -path "/opt/node*" 2>/dev/null | head -30

cd /app && echo "=== first 16 bytes (ELF magic) ==="; xxd -l 16 a.out; echo "=== .text start (file 0x1060) ==="; xxd -s 0x1060 -l 32 a.out; echo "=== bss region file offset 0x3010 (.comment) ==="; xxd -s 0x3010 -l 16 a.out; echo "=== node test: readUInt32LE of magic ==="; node -e "const b=require('fs').readFileSync('/app/a.out'); console.log('magic u32le =', b.readUInt32LE(0).toString(16), '=', b.readUInt32LE(0)); console.log('bytes4 u32le =', b.readUInt32LE(4));"
cd /app && cat -A extract.js | head -5; echo "==== FULL FILE ===="; cat extract.js

cd /app && rm -f out.json && node extract.js /app/a.out > out.json && echo "COMMAND SUCCEEDED (exit $?)" && echo "=== Artifacts in /app ===" && ls -la /app/extract.js /app/out.json && echo "=== out.json is valid JSON object ===" && node -e 'const o=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("/app/out.json","utf8")); const k=Object.keys(o); console.log("type:", typeof o, "| isArray:", Array.isArray(o)); console.log("entries:", k.length); console.log("first 3:", k.slice(0,3).map(x=>x+" -> "+o[x]).join(" | ")); console.log("value types all number:", k.every(x=>typeof o[x]==="number"));'

cd /app && echo "=== FINAL extract.js (full) ===" && cat extract.js && echo "" && echo "=== FINAL STATE ===" && ls -la /app/ && echo "" && echo "=== Re-run exact task command ===" && node extract.js /app/a.out > out.json && echo "exit=$?" && echo "out.json entries: $(node -e 'console.log(Object.keys(JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("/app/out.json","utf8"))).length)')" && echo "out.json first 150 chars:" && head -c 150 out.json && echo
